lines.text: A herald commands every nation to worship the statue when the music plays, or be thrown into the pit.
The three say God can deliver them, but even if He does not, they will not worship the statue.
Nebuchadnezzar has the furnace heated ten times hotter and mighty men of his army tie up the three.
The king sees four men walking unharmed in the fire, and the three come out with no smell of fire.
